protocol: OASIS KMIP Specification 1.4 TTLV over TLS 1.3 mutual TLS
required_interoperability: Query advertises Register and DiscoverVersions plus Symmetric Key Lifecycle Server 1.4 and Symmetric Key Foundry Server 1.4 profiles
DiscoverVersions returns only the supported 1.4 intersection
Register accepts an OASIS Raw AES-256 SymmetricKey object
Get with KeyWrappingSpecification returns AES-GCM Encrypt wrapping data with a 12-byte nonce and 16-byte authentication tag
Register unwraps the wrapped SymmetricKey and a raw Get reproduces the exact key material
all frames obey the 1 MiB, 4096-field, 16-level TTLV bounds
TLS 1.3 mutual authentication completes with no HTTP/2 ALPN coupling
envelope-sealed event replay preserves active, revoked, and destroyed object state across a fresh shipped runtime
